subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】mine 我的; yours 你的; his 他的; hers 她的; theirs 他们的; ours 我们的; climbing 爬; eating 吃; playing 玩; sleeping 睡觉; drinking 喝
【重点句型】Whose ... is this/are these? 这/这些是谁的……？ It's/They're ... 它/它们是……的。 The ... is/are ... 那个……是…… Is he ...? 他在……吗？ Can you ...? 你能……吗？
【A Let's talk】Sam: Whose dog is this? Chen Jie: Oh, it's mine. Sam: And those? Chen Jie: They're Sarah's. Amy: Look! The dogs are eating. Sam: They're so cute!
【Read and write】This is my dog. It is mine. That dog is yours. The red ball is his. The blue ball is hers. The cats are theirs. We are playing with our dogs. My dog is sleeping. Your dog is eating.
key_points: Whose ... is this/are these? 这/这些是谁的……？
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
